echo "===== 部署掉线自动愈合v1.0 287313 $(date '+%F %T') ====="
echo "[1]写脚本:"
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /root/azar_autoheal.sh
chmod +x /root/azar_autoheal.sh
bash -n /root/azar_autoheal.sh && echo "  语法OK md5=$(md5sum /root/azar_autoheal.sh|cut -c1-8)" || { echo "  语法失败,中止"; exit 1; }
echo "[2]拉起独立进程:"
pkill -f 'bash /root/azar_autoheal.sh' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
( setsid nohup bash /root/azar_autoheal.sh >> /root/autoheal.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & )
sleep 3
pgrep -af 'azar_autoheal' | head -2 || echo "  未拉起!"
echo "[3]写v6自启守卫(worker重启时自动带起autoheal):"
python3 -c "
p='/root/remote_ctl_v6.sh'; s=open(p).read()
g=\"pgrep -f 'bash /root/azar_autoheal.sh' >/dev/null || ( setsid nohup bash /root/azar_autoheal.sh >> /root/autoheal.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & )\n\"
if 'azar_autoheal' not in s:
    i=s.find('trap ')
    s=s[:i]+g+s[i:]; open(p,'w').write(s); print('  守卫已写入v6')
else: print('  v6已有守卫,跳过')
"
bash -n /root/remote_ctl_v6.sh && echo "  v6语法OK" || echo "  v6语法异常!"
echo "[4]自启守卫也写start_all.sh:"
python3 -c "
p='/root/start_all.sh'
import os
if not os.path.exists(p): print('  start_all.sh不存在,跳过'); raise SystemExit
s=open(p).read()
g=\"pgrep -f 'bash /root/azar_autoheal.sh' >/dev/null || ( setsid nohup bash /root/azar_autoheal.sh >> /root/autoheal.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & )\n\"
if 'azar_autoheal' not in s:
    open(p,'w').write(s.rstrip()+'\n'+g); print('  守卫已写入start_all')
else: print('  已有守卫,跳过')
"
echo "[5]验收:"
echo "  autoheal进程:"; pgrep -af 'azar_autoheal' | head -2
echo "  autoheal日志尾:"; tail -5 /root/autoheal.log 2>/dev/null
echo "=====完====="
